message: Last summer, we had a surprise blackout during a storm. Instead of panicking, I dug out my trusty lantern and we gathered in the living room, sharing stories and playing card games by its cozy glow. I even charged my phone with a power bank, so we could play our favorite tunes. It turned into such a fun night that I almost look forward to the next one! How do you make the best of an unexpected power outage?
